title: From Masking to Merging: Rethinking SpecAugment for Efficient Audio Spectrogram Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2609.13260v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes SpecAugment-Patch Merging, a simple yet effective method to accelerate Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) training. We first apply SpecAugment to mask input spectrograms at the patch level, and after positional embeddings are added, the method selects r pairs of masked patches and merges them, reducing the number of tokens processed by the Transformer. Increasing the number of merged pairs r from 0 to 100 keeps mAP on AudioSet nearly unchanged (34.07 to 34.08) while throughput increases from 43.3 to 49.3 samples/sec, which is a relatively 13.9% improvement. Similar patterns appear on ESC-50 and Speech Commands V2, where throughput steadily improves with only minor accuracy changes, demonstrating that this merging approach provides faster training with minimal performance loss.

translated_title: 从掩码到合并：重新思考SpecAugment以实现高效的音频频谱图Transformer
translated_abstract: 本文提出了SpecAugment-补丁合并，这是一种简单而有效的方法，用于加速音频频谱图Transformer（AST）的训练。我们首先应用SpecAugment在补丁级别对输入频谱图进行掩码，在添加位置嵌入后，该方法选择r对被掩码的补丁并进行合并，从而减少Transformer需要处理的token数量。将合并对数r从0增加到100，AudioSet上的mAP几乎保持不变（从34.07到34.08），而吞吐量从43.3提升到49.3样本/秒，相对提升13.9%。类似的结果也出现在ESC-50和Speech Commands V2数据集上，吞吐量稳步提升而精度仅有微小变化，这表明这种合并方法能够以最小的性能损失实现更快的训练。
tldr: 本文提出SpecAugment-补丁合并方法，通过合并被掩码的频谱图补丁来减少Transformer需处理的token数量，在几乎不损失精度的情况下将音频频谱图Transformer的训练吞吐量提升约13.9%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SpecAugment-Patch Merging, which merges masked spectrogram patches to reduce token count, boosting Audio Spectrogram Transformer training throughput by approximately 13.9% with nearly no accuracy loss.
